Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 select sponsor_id into :drives.sponsor_id
 from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = (select sponsor_id from drive_sponsors
 where drive_id = :drives.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and rownum = 1)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 select to_char(drive_date, 'DY') into :drives.day
 from drives
 where drive_date = :drives.drive_date
 and drive_id = :drives.drive_id
 and location_id = :drives.location_id;

 select initcap(location_name) into :drives.description from locations 
 where -- MG 8/14/99 location_type = 'FIX' -- FIX drive may not have fixed location type
 location_id = :drives.location_id
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1)
 and rownum = 1; --- This added by MG 8/14/99
 if :drives.projected_show is not null 
 and :drives.projected_draw is not null then
 if :drives.projected_draw > 0 then
 :drives.per_p_def := ((:drives.projected_show - :drives.projected_draw)/:drives.projected_show) * 100;
 else
 :drives.per_p_def := 0;
 end if;
 else
 :drives.per_p_def :=0;
 end if;
 select count(*) into :drives.actual_show
 from donations
 where drive_id = :drive_id;
 select count(*) into :drives.actual_draw
 from donations
 where drive_id = :drives.drive_id
 and unit_id is not null;
 select count(*) into :drives.actual_def
 from donations
 where drive_id = :drives.drive_id
 and deferral_id is not null;
if :drives.actual_show is not null then
 if :drives.actual_show > 0 then
 :drives.per_a_def := (:drives.actual_def/:drives.actual_show)* 100;
 else
 :drives.per_a_def := 0;
 end if;
else
 :drives.per_a_def := 0;
end if; 
exception
when no_data_found then
null;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_site_retrieve IS
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

 cursor cur_site(p_local_date in date) is Select location_id, location_name
 from locations
 where (location_id = :control_block.site_id
 or location_name like '%'||:control_block.site_id||'%')
 and location_type = 'FIX'
 and p_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, p_local_date+1)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- Added by Kishore on 01/31/2011. IM 4697
 order by 1;

 Cursor cur_site1(p_local_date in date) is select location_id, location_name
 from locations 
 where location_type='FIX' 
 and p_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,p_local_date+1)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- Added by Kishore on 01/31/2011. IM 4697
 order by 1;
BEGIN
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;


 go_block('options_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 
 If :control_block.site_id is not null then
 go_block('options_block');
 set_block_property('options_block',insert_allowed,property_true);
 FOR site_rec IN cur_site(v_local_date) loop
 :options_block.code:=site_rec.location_id;
 :options_block.description:=site_rec.location_name;
 :options_block.ck_sel_unsel:='Y';
 create_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 go_item('options_block._code');
 set_item_property('options_block.code',insert_allowed,property_false);
 -- set_item_property('options_block.description',insert_allowed,property_false);
 Else
 go_block('options_block');
 set_block_property('options_block',insert_allowed,property_true);
 FOR site_rec1 IN cur_site1(v_local_date) loop
 :options_block.code:=site_rec1.location_id;
 :options_block.description:=site_rec1.location_name;
 :options_block.ck_sel_unsel:='N';
 create_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 go_item('options_block.code');
 --set_block_property('options_block',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_item_property('options_block.code',insert_allowed,property_false);
 --set_item_property('options_block.description',insert_allowed,property_false);
End if;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOAD_OPTIONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE load_options (option_code varchar2)
 IS

 id_rg RecordGroup;
 id_gc GroupColumn;
 h_group_row_count number;
 h_tmp_code varchar2(10);
 h_tmp_description varchar2(50);
 h_tmp_hidden_code varchar2(10);
 curr_group_row number;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

 cursor cur_site(p_local_date in date) is
 select distinct location_id, location_name, location_id
 from locations
 where (location_id like nvl(:control_block.site_id, '') || '%'
 or location_name like '%'||:control_block.site_id|| '%')
 and locations.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and location_type = 'FIX'
 and p_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,p_local_date+1)
 order by 1; 
 
 
BEGIN
 :global.curitm := :system.cursor_item ;
 :control_block.s_search := null;
 id_rg := find_group('MULTI_SELECT_TMP');
 if not id_null(id_rg) then
 delete_group(id_rg);
 end if;

 id_rg := create_group('MULTI_SELECT_TMP');
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'CODE', CHAR_COLUMN, 10);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'DESCRIPTION', CHAR_COLUMN, 50);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'HIDDEN_CODE', CHAR_COLUMN, 10);
 :global.current_option := option_code;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 

 if option_code = 'SITE' then
 open cur_site(v_local_date);
 loop
 fetch cur_site
 into h_tmp_code, h_tmp_description, h_tmp_hidden_code;
 exit when cur_site%NOTFOUND;
 add_group_row(id_rg, END_OF_GROUP);
 curr_group_row := get_group_row_count(id_rg);
 set_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.CODE', curr_group_row, h_tmp_code);
 set_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.DESCRIPTION', curr_group_row, h_tmp_description);
 set_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.HIDDEN_CODE', curr_group_row, h_tmp_hidden_code);
 end loop;
 if cur_site%ISOPEN then
 close cur_site;
 end if;
 set_item_property('options_block.code',prompt_text,'Site');
 set_item_property('options_block.description',prompt_text,'Site Name');
 set_window_property('pop_window', title, 'Select Site');
 end if;
 /*
 ** using record group, populate the block and display it to the user
 */
 clear_message;
 show_window('pop_window');
 check_package_failure ;
 h_group_row_count := get_group_row_count(id_rg);
 message('Count-'||h_group_row_count);pause;
 go_block('options_block');
 check_package_failure ;
 clear_block(no_validate);
 check_package_failure ;
 set_block_property('options_block', insert_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('options_block', update_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('options_block', delete_allowed, property_false);

 for i in 1 .. h_group_row_count
 loop
 :options_block.code := get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.CODE', i);
 :options_block.description := get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.DESCRIPTION', i);
 :options_block.hidden_code := get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.HIDDEN_CODE', i);
 create_record;
 end loop;
 go_record(1);
 go_item('options_block.ck_sel_unsel');
 set_block_property('options_block', insert_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('options_block', update_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('options_block', delete_allowed, property_false);
 END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS
 where_clause varchar2(2000);
 where_clause1 varchar2(500);
 where_clause2 varchar2(500);
 where_clause3 varchar2(500);
 v_count number :=0;
 v_tot_pro_show number:=0;
 v_tot_pro_drw number:=0;
 v_tot_act_drw number:=0;
 v_tot_act_def number:=0;



BEGIN
 
 if :control_block.site_id is null and :control_block.sel_site_id is null and
 :control_block.s_start_date is not null and :control_block.s_end_date is not null then
 where_clause := ' chapter_id = :global.chapter_id '||
 ' and drive_date between :control_block.s_start_date and :control_block.s_end_date'||
 ' and status = ';
 where_clause1 := '''CNFRM''';
 where_clause := where_clause || where_clause1;
 where_clause2 := '''F''';
 where_clause := where_clause ||
 ' and drive_type in '||
 where_clause2;
elsif :control_block.site_id != 'MULTIPLE' and :control_block.sel_site_id is null
 and :control_block.s_start_date is not null 
 and :control_block.s_end_date is not null then
 where_clause := ' chapter_id = :global.chapter_id '||
 ' and drive_date between :control_block.s_start_date and :control_block.s_end_date'||
 ' and status = ';
 where_clause1 := '''CNFRM''';
 where_clause := where_clause || where_clause1;
 where_clause2 := '''F''';
 where_clause := where_clause ||
 ' and drive_type in '||
 where_clause2;
 where_clause3 := 'and location_id = :control_block.site_id';
 where_clause := where_clause||where_clause3;
elsif :control_block.site_id = 'MULTIPLE' and :control_block.sel_site_id is not null
 and :control_block.s_start_date is not null and :control_block.s_end_date is not null then

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_IN_STRING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_in_string (p_list_name in varchar2,
 p_in_string out varchar2)IS
 id_list ITEM;
 id_rg RecordGroup;
 id_gc GroupColumn;
 h_group_row_count number;

BEGIN
 /*
 ** first check if the list name is valid
 */
 id_list := Find_Item(p_list_name); 
 IF Id_Null(id_list) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '|| p_list_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 end if;

 id_rg := find_group('MULTI_SELECT_TMP');
 if not id_null(id_rg) then
 delete_group(id_rg);
 end if;

 -- re create the record group
 id_rg := create_group('MULTI_SELECT_TMP');
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'DESCRIPTION', CHAR_COLUMN, 50);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'CODE' , CHAR_COLUMN, 10);

-- message (p_list_name || ' - ' || get_list_element_count(id_list), acknowledge);
 if get_list_element_count(id_list) > 1 then
 retrieve_list(id_list, id_rg);
 h_group_row_count := get_group_row_count(id_rg);
 p_in_string := '(';
 for i in 1 .. h_group_row_count
 loop
-- message('Checking...' || get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.CODE', i), acknowledge);
 if get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.CODE', i) != 'MULTIXXXX' then
 p_in_string := p_in_string || in_quotes(get_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.CODE', i)) || ', ';
 end if;
 end loop;
 end if;
 p_in_string := rtrim(p_in_string, ', ') || ')';
-- message (p_in_string, acknowledge);
-- pause;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_TOTAL_PER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_total_per IS
BEGIN
 if :control_block.sum_p_draw is not null and
 :control_block.sum_p_show is not null then
 if :control_block.sum_p_draw > 0 then
 :control_block.sum_per_p_def := ((:control_block.sum_p_show - :control_block.sum_p_draw)/:control_block.sum_p_show) * 100;
 else
 :control_block.sum_per_p_def := 0;
 end if;
 else
 :control_block.sum_per_p_def := 0;
 end if;
 
 if :control_block.sum_a_draw is not null and
 :control_block.sum_a_def is not null then
 if (:control_block.sum_a_draw + :control_block.sum_a_def)> 0 then
 :control_block.sum_per_a_def := (:control_block.sum_a_def/(:control_block.sum_a_draw + :control_block.sum_a_def)) * 100;
 else
 :control_block.sum_per_a_def := 0;
 end if;
 else
 :control_block.sum_per_a_def := 0;
 end if;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_SEARCH_RETRIEVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_search_retrieve IS

v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;


 cursor cur_site(p_local_date in date) is Select location_id, location_name
 from locations
 where (location_id like '%'||:control_block.s_search||'%'
 or location_name like '%'||:control_block.s_search||'%')
 and location_type = 'FIX'
 and p_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, p_local_date+1)order by 1;

 Cursor cur_site1(p_local_date in date) is select location_id, location_name
 from locations 
 where location_type='FIX' 
 and p_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,p_local_date+1) order by 1;
BEGIN
 
 go_block('options_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;


 If :control_block.s_search is not null then
 go_block('options_block');
 set_block_property('options_block',insert_allowed,property_true);

 FOR site_rec IN cur_site(v_local_date) loop
 :options_block.code:=site_rec.location_id;
 :options_block.description:=site_rec.location_name;
 :options_block.ck_sel_unsel:='Y';
 create_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 go_item('options_block._code');
 set_item_property('options_block.code',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_item_property('options_block.description',insert_allowed,property_false);
 Else
 go_block('options_block');
 set_block_property('options_block',insert_allowed,property_true);

 FOR site_rec1 IN cur_site1(v_local_date) loop
 :options_block.code:=site_rec1.location_id;
 :options_block.description:=site_rec1.location_name;
 :options_block.ck_sel_unsel:='N';
 create_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 go_item('options_block.code');
 set_item_property('options_block.code',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_item_property('options_block.description',insert_allowed,property_false);
End if;

END;
